pages.title: INTRODUCING MEMGPT: REVOLUTIONARY ADVANCE IN AI
pages.content: Generative AI speeds ahead, but language models struggle due to limited token windows. Hence, recalling conversation details is a challenge. MemGPT, an innovative open-source framework addresses this issue, enabling 'Extended' memory for models with no token constraints.
pages.image_prompt: A futuristic image featuring the interface of a conversational AI system on a digital screen, with visible lines of code, language processing symbols and icons. Next to the screen, include a technical open-source emblem to signify the open-source aspect of MemGPT. The background is a fast-paced matrix of binary numbers illustrating the speed and advancement of generative AI.

pages.title: HOW DOES MEMGPT WORK?
pages.content: MemGPT uses a virtual machine concept with a memory management system. It houses a Core for essential facts, Recall for specific memories, and an Archival for important data storage. All this enables replicating unlimited memory capacities in AI models.
pages.image_prompt: An image of a conceptualized virtual machine, with distinct sections labeled as 'Core', 'Recall', and 'Archival', visualizing the multi-tiered memory management system of MemGPT. Each section shows abstract visual representations: 'Core' storing dots representing facts, 'Recall' having lines targeting specific memories, and 'Archival' housing boxes symbolizing important stored data. The virtual machine is enveloped by unlimited chains of tokens, illustrating the unlimited memory capacity of AI models.
